# Getting help

| I want to...                         | Go to                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Ask a usage question or share an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/blessinglinus698-coder/accesscraft/discussions) |
| Report a reproducible bug            | [New issue](https://github.com/blessinglinus698-coder/accesscraft/issues/new/choose) |
| Report a security vulnerability      | [Private advisory](https://github.com/blessinglinus698-coder/accesscraft/security/advisories/new) |
| Contribute code or docs              | [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)                                  |

Before asking, please check the README and search existing issues and discussions.

AccessCraft is maintained by volunteers. We do our best to respond promptly, but we cannot guarantee response times.
